criteria.name: Thumb-stop cover
criteria.notes: Headline reads instantly at 432px and there is one focal object, but the hook carries no number, place or named party that survives the thumb, and the middle third is an empty pale gradient between the glider and the type.

criteria.name: Story arc & swipe momentum
criteria.notes: Real beat structure with a paid turn: the list is stated, shown, staked in Alaska at 03, specified, broken against itself at 07, paid off in the analyst's margin at 08. Slides 04, 05 and 06 are three parallel specification beats that reorder without loss.

criteria.name: Artwork craft & genuine detail
criteria.notes: Rule, printed panel, graticule and PBR cover all gained real detail, but four of nine frames are the same ruled eight-column card redrawn, so more than half the deck's art is one drawing function, and the cover's cradle still does not read as a cradle.

criteria.name: Story-art fusion
criteria.notes: The art parameters ARE the story's numbers and the engine audits them: 8 vs 8 channels, 8 vs 7 with the absent column hatched, the 11 dB boundary at 585 vs 585 px, 36 marks for 36 records, the 45 minute gap drawn to 45.

criteria.name: Alaska authenticity & local relevance
criteria.notes: Chukchi Sea, unit 595, UAF, a true coastline with a 20 KM bar, AKDT, and subsistence harvest sourced to three NOAA Fisheries pages. The stake rests on one slide and no Alaskan village, borough or person appears on any frame.

criteria.name: Insight density & factual weight
criteria.notes: Every content slide adds a new verified specific, bodies run 25 to 50 words with no filler, and the refusal to gloss Mn, Air gun or walrus is real editorial weight.

criteria.name: Variety vs ledger
criteria.notes: The value inversion is a real break from three consecutive dark-ground decks, but a 0.500 max art pair says two frames are half the same drawing, and staged objects on a lit surface is the fourth visit in eight runs.

criteria.name: Legibility & platform fitness
criteria.notes: Warns 134 to 60 to 58, safe-zone warns 18 to 5, zero fails, vector PDF with title. Several squeakers remain rather than one defect: five safe-zone breaks and the '11' numeral at 4.4 worst point.

criteria.name: Copy: voice & hook
criteria.notes: Hook lands at 109 chars on a real particular, 883 chars, 0.61 commas per 100 words, names a human. The Q and A scaffold in the middle is slightly mechanical.

criteria.name: Deliverable completeness
criteria.notes: Post copy, three hashtags, seven-source first comment, vector PDF, nine thumbs, contact sheet, aftercare and editor notes all present. Image URLs resolve only after the merge.

threshold_note: Scored against the unrelaxed 8.3. The iteration ladder would allow 8.0 at three revision rounds; it was not needed and was not applied.
one_sentence_fix: Re-shape the contact casts on slides 02 and 07 from a hard-edged full-width block into a penumbra that narrows and fades laterally at roughly dL 35 to 45 rather than 70, because those two black bars are the deck's most visible artifact at thumbnail.

post_score_change.what: The scorer's one_sentence_fix was applied after scoring and before ship. castUnder() was rebuilt from a single full-width rect into 160 lateral slices with a smoothstep falloff and a depth that eases off at the corners, and slide 04's two footer separators went from #7A8A80 at weight 500 to #3E5049 at weight 700.
post_score_change.measured: Contact dL after the change: S02 37.8 (was 69.4), S07 48.3 (was 70.4), S04 22.4 (was 51.3); S01 22.2, S03 10.6, S05 8.2 unchanged. All clear the 8.0 comfort band. machine_qa warns 60 to 58, still 0 fails.
post_score_change.not_rescored: The deck was NOT re-scored after this change. It is the scorer's own prescribed fix, applied narrowly to the defect it named, and it moves the weakest criterion in the direction the scorer asked for. The 8.51 above is therefore a floor for the shipped pixels, not a description of them.

editor_notes_for_email: SHIPS at 8.51 against 8.3 with no hard fail. The cycle-2 blocker, slide 04's clipped footer strip reading '8 KB PER HOURNOT EVERY DETECTED CALL IS SENT', is verifiably fixed in the pixels; the strip is now laid out from measured advance widths and throws at render time if the slack goes negative. machine_qa is 0 fails and 58 warns, pdf_mode vector at 6.08MB. Two things worth knowing. (1) Slide 04's axis numeral '11' measures 4.4:1 at its worst pixel against a 5.0 box mean; it is a 30px bold data label well inside the WCAG large-text floor and it reads, but it is the one contrast reading in the deck under 4.5. (2) Slide 05's data-scale declaration was silently truncated all run by an apostrophe inside a single-quoted HTML attribute, so that slide's two declared axes were never audited until this round; the text was rewritten and both now parse. Nothing in the pipeline failed on it, which is logged as the run's top machine-upgrade candidate. On the post itself, honour the aftercare list: the deck deliberately refuses to name a species for the code Mn, refuses to gloss Air gun, and deliberately leaves walrus out of the subsistence sentence because the fact-checker could not source it. Do not fill any of those three gaps in a comment reply.
